reward: clamp(post-turn HP fraction of exposed own member / its pre-action HP fraction, 0, 1)
learner: unchanged F1 928x64x14 bounded-value network; unchanged F2 PPO; 2 Adam steps per 128-row update with valid padding
continuation: one final-policy decision per context/panel/seed, followed by frozen base-power play to natural terminal or turn-120 cutoff
interpretation: local contextual-bandit learnability diagnostic, not terminal-reward full-battle RL or curriculum-transfer evidence
gate_scope: every family and panel plus every context, for all three seeds; diagnostic thresholds, not significance
